originals.why: The course taught cymryd as 시간을 들이다 ('take time'), but 'cymryd gormod' here means 'take too much' (a quantity). There's no Korean that keeps the gloss and still leads to exactly one Welsh answer.

refill.why: Sound, but only 1 USE was needed and U06 is the cleaner fit.
Only 1 needed; 'cario ymlaen i ddysgu' sounds less natural than U06.
'다른 것을 가지고 노는 걸' is awkward Korean for 'chwarae rhywbeth arall'.
Only 1 needed; the embedded 'dw i'n meddwl dylet ti' frame is weaker than U06's plain dylet ti.
Only 1 needed; '너는 네가 멈추는 게 좋겠다고 생각해?' is clunky.
Only 1 needed; the negated embedded frame is weaker than U06.

topups.ko: 너는 다시 너 자신에게 묻고 싶어?
topups.why: 'wyt ti isio' is a question, so the Korean needs to be one too.

topups.ko: 너는 네가 준비가 됐는지 너 자신에게 물어볼 수 있어
답이 무엇인지 너 자신에게 묻는 게 중요해
네가 준비가 됐는지 너 자신에게 묻는 게 유용해
너는 답이 무엇인지 너 자신에게 물어볼 거야?
topups.why: 'wyt ti'n mynd i' is a question, so the Korean needs to be one too.
'왜 너 자신에게 묻지 않아' could equally be 'pam dwyt ti ddim yn gofyn i dy hun', and there's no gloss-faithful Korean that points only to 'pam ddim'.
